name: Lee Wilkers
lede: Hi, I’m Lee. I’m an independent consultant in Atlanta, by way of the DC area. GOODNEIGHBOR is my design practice.
workExamples: global health ethics — deliberative approaches to difficult decisions and controversial issues in population health
community engagement and participatory design — research and co-design methods for communities and health-program teams
program design and organizational learning — decision tools, evaluation frameworks, and practical guidance for health-program teams
care for survivors of intimate partner violence — trauma-informed interviews and research on care coordination
Brokered Dialogue — filmed exchanges that explore disagreement and the experiences behind people’s positions
behavioral research and design — applying consumer psychology to public-health communication and participation
